before.title: Continuous Benchmark Evaluation for Enterprise Retrieval Pipelines
before.summary: Static benchmarks fail to capture domain drift in enterprise knowledge bases. We establish a synthetic test generator that auto-creates paired evaluation sets whenever new corpora are ingested.
before.text_for_embedding:
Title: Continuous Benchmark Evaluation for Enterprise Retrieval Pipelines
Authors: Quang Le, Yen Vu
Published: 2026-07-22
Categories: Evaluation Methodology, Enterprise Systems
Summary: Static benchmarks fail to capture domain drift in enterprise knowledge bases. We establish a synthetic test generator that auto-creates paired evaluation sets whenever new corpora are ingested.

before.title: Multi-Agent Consensus for High-Stakes Fact Verification
before.summary: A single LLM is susceptible to confirmation bias when evaluating retrieved evidence. We demonstrate a multi-agent debate architecture where specialized verifier agents critique and corroborate citations.
before.text_for_embedding:
Title: Multi-Agent Consensus for High-Stakes Fact Verification
Authors: Phong Vu, Ngan Hoang
Published: 2026-07-19
Categories: Multi-Agent Systems, Artificial Intelligence
Summary: A single LLM is susceptible to confirmation bias when evaluating retrieved evidence. We demonstrate a multi-agent debate architecture where specialized verifier agents critique and corroborate citations.

before.title: Freshness SLAs for Real-Time LLM Knowledge Augmentation
before.summary: We define freshness service-level agreements (SLAs) for temporal document ingestion. By tracking document age and update cadence, our orchestrator dynamically prioritizes recrawling high-churn technical corpora.
before.text_for_embedding:
Title: Freshness SLAs for Real-Time LLM Knowledge Augmentation
Authors: Bao Do, Linh Ngo
Published: 2026-07-05
Categories: Data Management, Artificial Intelligence
Summary: We define freshness service-level agreements (SLAs) for temporal document ingestion. By tracking document age and update cadence, our orchestrator dynamically prioritizes recrawling high-churn technical corpora.

before.title: Synthetic Corruption Testing: Stress-Testing Vector Search Robustness
before.summary: We introduce an automated fuzzing suite that corrupts text chunks by injecting noise, truncating titles, and blanking summaries. Experiments reveal critical failure thresholds for dense embedding retrieval.
before.text_for_embedding:
Title: Synthetic Corruption Testing: Stress-Testing Vector Search Robustness
Authors: Kien Duong, Vy Ly
Published: 2026-06-25
Categories: Robustness, Information Retrieval
Summary: We introduce an automated fuzzing suite that corrupts text chunks by injecting noise, truncating titles, and blanking summaries. Experiments reveal critical failure thresholds for dense embedding retrieval.

before.title: Data Observability and Quality Gates for Production RAG Systems
before.summary: Silent data corruption in RAG pipelines degrades LLM answer faithfulness without throwing runtime errors. We introduce automated quality gates using Great Expectations 1.x to catch stale and malformed embeddings before serving.
before.text_for_embedding:
Title: Data Observability and Quality Gates for Production RAG Systems
Authors: Anh Tran, Quoc Pham
Published: 2026-06-12
Categories: Software Engineering, Data Systems
Summary: Silent data corruption in RAG pipelines degrades LLM answer faithfulness without throwing runtime errors. We introduce automated quality gates using Great Expectations 1.x to catch stale and malformed embeddings before serving.
